guideline: Using a Likert scale of 1-5 to assess fluency and adequacy.
Raters assessed adequacy and fluency using a 1‑5 Likert scale after listening to the source speech (ASR) or reading the translations (MT).

After listening to the source speech they assess fluency (how natural and grammatically correct the transcription sounds in their dialect) and adequacy (how accurately the transcription conveys the meaning of the source speech) using a Likert scale of (1-5), the higher the better.
